html:
Princess Juliana Airport opened on the Dutch side of Saint Martin in 1943 as a military airstrip during World War II. It became the main airport of the northeastern Caribbean.

Jets landing there pass low over Maho Beach, a sight that draws crowds. Flights connect to small islands nearby such as Saint Barthelemy, Anguilla and Saba.

The airport turned Sint Maarten into a cruise and holiday hub and drew migrants from all over the region to work in hotels. It was badly damaged by Hurricane Irma in 2017.
